data.verdict: THE α_EM PER-LOOP 8π IS NOT GAUSS–BONNET (scope-(a)). Bring is genus 4: its Gauss–Bonnet invariants are −χ=2g−2=6 and area=−2πχ=12π. The per-loop constant is 8 / 8π — neither the Euler number 6 nor the area 12π (8π is the GB area only at genus 5). (1) The '8' is the homological b₁=2g=8 (#3896), NOT the GB Euler number −χ=6. (2) The polarized determinant measure 8.226285 matches no GB invariant of Bring: measure/12π=0.21821, measure/6=1.371, measure/6π=0.43642; it is π-free, at b₁=8 (2.8% off). The Polyakov/conformal-anomaly π (∫R=4πχ) is divided out by holomorphic factorization. So 8π splits as (count b₁=8)×(flat heat-kernel π, #3909), not a single GB area. The π·φ²=1.000181 near-hit (0.018%) is a coincidence (Bring A₅/golden symmetry is tempting but the digits kill it), not an identity. Residual 2.8% remains for the q-holomorphic Φ_b deformation.
